title: Protected Unit Price for Long-Standing Cartwise+ Annual Members
content:
# Protected unit price for long-standing Cartwise+ annual members

Member benefit note — Cartwise+ Membership benefits on Cartwise Grocery Orders replacement lines chosen by the shopper without the customer's approval.

The protected unit price, the price per unit a replacement is held to for price protection, depends on the Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order:

- **Annual plan, enrolled at least 24 whole calendar months before the order's placed date** — the protected unit price is the original unit price itself.
- **Annual plan, enrolled at least 12 and fewer than 24 whole calendar months before the order's placed date** — the protected unit price is the average of the original unit price and the replacement's billed unit price.
- **Any other membership position** — a monthly plan of any tenure, an annual plan enrolled fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the placed date, or no Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order — does not alter how the protected unit price is set.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date. The earlier date is the enrolled date of the membership in the Cartwise+ Membership records; the later date is the order's placed date.

## Where the facts sit

The Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order at checkout names the plan, whose billing cycle is monthly or annual, and carries the enrolled date. The order carries its placed date. The replacement line's billed entry carries the original unit price and the billed unit price.

## Illustration (hypothetical prices and dates)

Original unit price 3.00; replacement billed at 3.90.

| Membership recorded on the order | Whole months enrolled before the placed date | Protected unit price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Annual plan | 30 | 3.00 |
| Annual plan | 24 | 3.00 |
| Annual plan | 23 | 3.45 (average of 3.00 and 3.90) |
| Annual plan | 12 | 3.45 |
| Annual plan | 11 | not altered by the membership |
| Monthly plan | 40 | not altered by the membership |

Anniversary check: an annual plan enrolled on 20 June, on an order placed 19 June two years later, has 23 whole months (the 24th anniversary falls on 20 June); on an order placed 20 June two years later it has 24.
